integrity: The proof is self-contained after the standard semisimple module decomposition and the classical invariant-summand characterization of strong cleanness. Finite checks are corroborative and are not used as a substitute for the general proof.
scientific_limitations: The exact multiplicity formula is proved for semisimple matrices only. An equivalent formula could exist under centralizer or module-decomposition terminology not surfaced by the inspected literature.
title: Exact strong-clean decomposition multiplicities for semisimple finite-field matrices
